notes.title: Alinea Analytics: Gears of War: Reloaded продаётся на PlayStation 5 хуже, чем Helldivers 2 на Xbox Series X|S
notes.notes: Alinea Analytics продолжает делиться результатами "обмена играми" между Sony и Microsoft. По оценкам аналитического агентства, владельцы PlayStation 5 встретили Gears of War: Reloaded без повышенного энтузиазма — игра показала достойный старт, но это не хит уровня Forza Horizon 5 — за первую неделю было продано порядка 259 тысяч копий.

notes.title: Gears of War: Reloaded is available now!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609665/f065abc966aa8a85d1401110006b5b8fb9046ddb.png"][/img][/p][p]In It’s finally time to jump into the action in [b][i]Gears of War: Reloaded[/i][/b], out on Steam today. For many of us, it’s a welcome return to one of gaming’s most iconic stories, but for many more, it’s the first time you’ll be stepping into the extra-large boots of Marcus and Dom. We’re thrilled that so many new players can experience their story for the first time ever – and whether you’re a seasoned veteran of the Locust War or picking up a Lancer for the first time - here’s everything you need to know, plus some exclusive extra insight from inside The Coalition.[/p][p] 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609665/0ee03263deb18bcf5e59197d978f6d554e7491ba.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]The Classic Returns, Better than Ever[/b][/p][p]It’s been almost 20 years since [i]Gears of War[/i] first made its way onto the Xbox 360, and the release of Reloaded is just the start of how the studio plans to honor the milestone, says Mike Crump, Studio Head at The Coalition.[/p][p]“We really felt that bringing back the game that started it all - and bringing it to more players and more platforms than ever before – was the perfect way to kick off a celebration of 20 years of Gears,” Crump adds. “I’m jealous of everyone who’s about to experience Gears for the first time because I remember what an amazing experience that was!”[/p][p]In [i]Gears of War: Reloaded[/i], every aspect of the original game has been brought to modern standards – art, audio, cinematics... everything - to deliver a new, enhanced experience. With stunning 4K resolution, assets and textures, a 60 FPS, campaign with lightning fast load times and 120 FPS in multiplayer, this the ultimate way to play [i]Gears of War, [/i]and it’ll feel spectacular no matter how many times you’ve experienced this story before.[/p][p]“It’s always fascinating to see the difference between what you remember your favourite games looking like and what they actually looked like,” Crump says. “Gears of War set a new bar for graphical fidelity in 2006, and that’s what I remember about it – being in awe of how great it looked. Of course, the bar has moved a lot higher since then. Upgrading and enhancing such a beloved game for today’s generation of hardware has been a labor of love for The Coalition.”[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609665/77078401f152ebee7dbc91db5022b1bf5809db87.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Squad Up Across Platforms[/b][/p][p]With so many new platforms joining the fight, [i]Gears of War: Reloaded[/i] is built to support squads without restriction. Cross-play functionality means that players across Steam Xbox, and PlayStation can party up together, whether its to take on the Campaign in two-player co-op mode, or team up in Versus Multiplayer, which supports up to 8 players, providing all party members are signed into a Microsoft account.[/p][p]Not only does signing in with a Microsoft account allow for cross-platform parties, it also enables cross-progression. Allowing your Campaign and multiplayer progress to carry across devices for a seamless experience wherever you play. It also allows you to send invites and play with friends across platforms — like Xbox to PlayStation or Steam to Xbox.[/p][p]With the 20[i]th[/i] anniversary of Gears of War around the corner, we couldn’t help but ask The Coalition to share some of their favourite Gears moments to look back on (and we’ve kept it spoiler-free).[/p][p]“The terror of encountering the Berserker will be forever etched into my memory,” says Crump. “The way she’s introduced is an ‘oh shit’ moment for the ages!”[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609665/2ff6db042701b7c3b01f42afbc0e3785ec555fd5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Gears of War[/i] set a new bar for graphical fidelity in 2006, and that’s what I remember about it – being in awe of how great it looked. Of course, the bar has moved a lot higher since then. Upgrading and enhancing such a beloved game for today’s generation of hardware has been a labor of love for The Coalition.”[/p]

notes.title: Gears of War: Reloaded PC performance: The updated graphics are easy work for any desktop GPU from the past six years but they're still enough to give handhelds grief
notes.notes: If you were hoping that Gears of War: Reloaded was going to be like The Elder Scrolls 4: Oblivion Remastered, then I have a bit of bad news for you. It's essentially 2016's Ultimate Edition of Gears of War, but with better lighting and textures—everything else, including meshes, animations, and the overall gameplay, is exactly the same... Read more.

notes.title: Gears of War: Reloaded (PS5) Review
notes.notes:
There is a strange comfort and surprise in booting up Gears of War: Reloaded and seeing The Coalition’s logo on a PlayStation system. The familiar thrum of a chainsaw revving, the weighty stomp of armoured boots in a war-torn city or underground, and the bark of Lancer fire all come flooding back in an instant. For longtime fans, it is the sort of thing that pulls you immediately into muscle memory. But nostalgia, as always, is a double-edged blade, and Reloaded makes it clear just how much the series has aged in both design and feel.

This is not a ground-up reimagining. It is not a sweeping reinvention or bold reinterpretation of what Gears of War could be in 2025. Reloaded is, for better and worse, a preservation piece with a few modern flourishes. Its task is to bring the original trilogy into sharper focus while stitching it together in a way that makes sense for new players. And while the facelift is impressive, the longer you spend with it, the harder it becomes to ignore... Read more

notes.title: I'm as surprised as you are, but Gears of War: Reloaded is showing every other major publisher how a remake should be handled
notes.notes: Today's Xbox Games Showcase gave us a new look at Gears of War: Reloaded, the remake of the 2006 original that kickstarted the series and made good on all of Xbox 360's HD promises. I don't particularly follow Gears but I have a lot of love for the first game in the series, which was simply a blast to play through in singleplayer, and had a genuinely great multiplayer mode that took full advantage of those slick-as-hell movement and combat mechanics... Read more.

notes.title: If you yearn for 2006, steel yourself for Gears of War: Reloaded's multiplayer beta this coming weekend
notes.notes: I don't have children, but if I did, I'm pretty sure I'd love Gears of War more than them. That was always because of the campaigns and horde mode, but I'm still up for a few rounds of deathmatch—and if you're as eager as I am to revisit the gory glory of the Xbox 360 era, you won't have to wait long... Read more.
